title: BCF: issues, not models
sub: How to say “the problem is right here”
cards/0/title: An issue instead of a model
cards/0/body:
Finding a clash is only half the job. You have to hand it to whoever will fix it.

BCF (BIM Collaboration Format, from buildingSMART) is not a model but an issue: a title, a status, an assignee, a camera viewpoint, a screenshot and the GlobalIds of the elements. The model itself is not inside.
cards/1/task: Find the clash between duct D-7 and beam B-12 and create a BCF issue for it.
cards/2/q: Which line points to a specific element in the model?
cards/2/code:
<Topic Guid="7c1e…" TopicStatus="Open">
  <Title>Duct D-7 × Beam B-12</Title>
</Topic>
<Component IfcGuid="0Np4AyS5p7Th2Wg9Va4Ij3"/>
<PerspectiveCamera>…</PerspectiveCamera>
cards/2/explain: IfcGuid is the same GlobalId from IFC. Any program can use it to find the duct in its own copy of the model.
cards/3/q: Why is BCF tiny even when the model weighs gigabytes?
cards/3/options/0: It has no geometry: only GlobalId references, a camera and a screenshot
cards/3/explain: Every participant has their own copy of the model. BCF tells them where to look in it.
cards/4/body:
It is a zip archive. Each issue gets a folder with markup.bcf (XML: title, comments, status), viewpoint.bcfv (camera, visible and selected elements) and snapshot.png.

There is also the BCF API for exchanging issues through the cloud, with no files.
cards/5/items/1: The coordinator created a BCF with a camera and GlobalIds
cards/5/items/2: The engineer opened the BCF and saw the same spot
cards/5/items/3: They fixed the model and closed the issue
cards/5/explain: BCF connects people and programs without sending the model itself.
cards/6/q: What is inside a BCF? Select all.
cards/7/q: Will a BCF open in a different program from the one that created it?
cards/7/options/0: Yes, if it supports BCF: it is an open buildingSMART standard
cards/7/options/1: No, only in the same one
cards/7/explain: BCF is supported by Revit, Archicad, Solibri, BIMcollab, Navisworks (via plugins) and many others.
